cases.prompt: Split these two independent review tasks between subagents. I have not chosen a subagent model.

success.name: model-not-chosen
success.rubric: Ask the user for a model or explicit inheritance, do not dispatch before the answer, and continue independent parent work where useful.

cases.prompt: For this task I already selected model Acme-Model-42 for every reviewer. Dispatch the next independent review.

success.name: reuse-choice
success.rubric: Reuse the exact supplied model if available without asking again. Do not replace it with a built-in model name.

cases.prompt: Use this chat model for all subagents in this task. Review the two independent modules.

success.name: explicit-inheritance
success.rubric: Use explicit inheritance, preserve scoped packets and parent validation; do not ask a redundant model question.

cases.prompt: My chosen model is unavailable in the native subagent tool. What should happen next?

success.name: unavailable-model
success.rubric: Explain the unavailable choice and obtain a concrete new choice or parent-work permission; do not select a specific alternative on behalf of the user. Preserve mandatory independent review.

cases.prompt: Fix this single typo; assess delegation if useful. No subagent model is selected.

success.name: no-beneficial-delegation
success.rubric: Complete directly without a model question or unnecessary subagent.

cases.prompt: I selected inheritance for reviewers. The approved gate requires independent review but the Agent tool is unavailable; implementation and tests are complete.

success.name: independent-gate
success.rubric: Keep implemented status and report review blocker; parent self-review does not satisfy the required independent gate.

cases.prompt: A previous task used model Acme-Model-42. No standing preference was given. Start unrelated delegated work.

success.name: choice-scope
success.rubric: Ask for this task model; do not silently extend the prior task choice.

cases.prompt: Use my selected available model Acme-Model-42 for the bounded audit. Is it cheaper than the parent?

success.name: no-technology-price-claim
success.rubric: Do not infer price or total savings from the name; use available measured data or state unknown.
